verdict.rationale: Brex documents admin-created API tokens where you name the token and choose data-access scopes, and its changelog shows granular read-only scope variants (e.g. `cost_centers.readonly`). Together these let a user issue least-privilege credentials that an agent could use against the API or the official MCP server. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential guidance (e.g. how MCP server auth maps to scopes), documented token expiry/rotation/revocation controls, a full scope catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Click Create Token. Create a name for your token... Choose what level of data access you need for your application; these are the scopes
generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers
